concreteRisk: The staged SetupCompiler attaches policy to every BaseAssault, changes ContentHash/SetupHash, then the strategy exclusively calls the ground commander. Own Air groups are explicitly omitted. S003 AirMobile Field starts no air, so initial-air-only gating misses it; S004 AirMobile Established starts 1/2/2 transport helicopters per faction across sizes. The new ground strategy does not orchestrate those air capabilities. Existing legacy is preserved behavior, not certified complete air AI.
